info.title: Credex Core API
info.description: API documentation for the Credex Core system. This API provides endpoints for managing members, accounts, Credex transactions, and recurring payments.

devAdminAuth.name: x-dev-admin-key
devAdminAuth.description: Development admin API key for authentication

post.description:
Creates a new member account with default tier 1 and associated personal account.
The process includes:
- Creating member with initial tier 1 status
- Creating personal account with specified denomination
- Generating authentication token
- Retrieving initial dashboard state

phone.description: International phone number format (digits only, no + prefix)

message.example: John Smith: Personal account created with a default denomination of USD.

actor.description: ID of the member that was created

memberHandle.description: Member's unique handle (initially set to phone number)

token.description: Authentication token for the new member

defaultAccountID.description: ID of the created personal account

memberHandle.description: Member's handle (initially set to phone number)

accounts.description: List of accounts accessible to the member (initially just personal account)

accountType.description: Type of the account (PERSONAL for new members)

isOwnedAccount.description: Whether the member owns this account (true for personal account)

sendOffersTo.description: Member configured to receive offers for this account

totalPayables.description: Total payables in account default denomination

totalReceivables.description: Total receivables in account default denomination

netPayRec.description: Net payables/receivables in account default denomination

netCredexAssetsInDefaultDenom.description: Net credex assets in account default denomination

post.description: Creates a new recurring transaction schedule. Supports REGULAR, DCO_GIVE, and MEMBERTIER_SUBSCRIPTION template types. For subscriptions, targetAccountID is optional (defaults to greatsun_ops) and auto-acceptance is applied.

payFrequency.description: Number of days between payments (28 for subscriptions)

dashboard.description: Full dashboard state after the action
